name: v0.4.17 — Latest build
releaseNotes:
• Smashlist: cleaner cards (store name headlines each card, no repeated store per item) plus a quick Add-item button and per-row delete.
• Receipts list uses one consistent font.
• In-app sign-up fixed (Turnstile step) and other stability fixes.

Uninstall the old app first, then install this one fresh.
